content:
[L] high | chat message area (right panel, ~y285) | the customer's chat message bubble is clipped mid-line, showing only the top sliver of a truncated message text
[L] high | window bottom | the application content ends at ~y570 leaving the lower ~40% of the window completely empty black void, a massive rendering/panel failure
[L] high | chat transcript (right panel) | only one message with a cut-off bubble and an "open" pill renders; the transcript is broken/incomplete with content visibly cut off
[H] high | top-left headers | "Live chats", "Chats", "Chat with Kim One" and metadata lines all sit at near-identical small sizes, so no heading visually dominates; hierarchy collapses
[H] med | right panel header | raw debug strings like "state: open · mailbox #3 · last event 2026-02-16T09:41:00.000Z" and "customer 7 not in the mirror yet" are exposed as primary UI text with internal jargon
[H] med | chat message row | full ISO timestamp "2026-02-16T09:39:10.000Z" with milliseconds rendered at equal weight to the sender name, mixed metadata/content
[C] high | window lower half | enormous dead black zone below the UI reads as an unfinished debug build rather than a product
[S] med | left list vs right panel | chat list panel is ~370px wide but contains one card and then vast empty whitespace while the right panel is cramped, an unbalanced split
[S] med | right panel top | three stacked text lines ("Chat with Kim One", state line, "customer 7...") have inconsistent gaps and no clear grouping or separation
[S] low | filter row | "View:" label baseline does not align with the "Open chats"/"Ended chats" toggle pills beside it
[H] low | chat list card | name, ISO timestamp, and preview snippet all rendered at nearly the same weight/size, so the card has no scannable structure
[H] low | bottom hint lines | "the message id is generated here — a retry can never double-send" developer commentary displayed as user-facing footer text
[C] low | right panel | "open" status pill floats alone between message bubble and system notice with no grouping or context

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped content, a giant black dead zone, leaked debug strings, and collapsed hierarchy make this look like an unfinished internal tool, not shippable software.
